subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled workaround?
rationale: The code change is small, but launch defaults affect all managed/sandbox browser users and the existing `browser.extraArgs` workaround already covers local managed profiles; maintainer intent is needed after live Chrome proof.

options.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
options.body: Run live Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document operator control only
options.body: Keep built-in defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add an explicit config knob
options.body: Introduce a dedicated suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing `extraArgs` surface is insufficient for this class of launch policy.

recommendation.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
recommendation.body: Run live Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on browser launcher ownership and already reviewed the stale related PR's replacement shape.
